title: Create, edit, retire a plan; link Stripe prices
caption: Stripe linking needs FEATURE_STRIPE_BILLING and Stripe test keys on the platform API.

steps.title: New plan
steps.body: **New plan**: code, name, currency, monthly (and optional yearly) price, trial days, limits (staff seats, API keys, custom domains, may go live), feature rows, 'Public' (off by default), order, settlement fee (bps).
steps.expect: Field problems shown at each field with focus on the first, nothing sent; on success the plan is active and the form says whether the pricing page offers it.

steps.title: Edit the plan
steps.body: **Edit the plan**, change a limit, save. Open the page in two tabs and save both.
steps.expect: 'The plan is saved'; the second save is refused as stale (412) with a full-reload link; typed values kept.

steps.title: Link Stripe prices
steps.body: **Link Stripe prices**: `prod_…`, `price_…` monthly and yearly → **Save the links**; then **Check prices**.
steps.expect: Saved even with warnings; each warning in words next to its price; one price for both intervals refused at the yearly field; `502` says nothing was saved.

steps.title: Retire and reactivate
steps.body: **Retire plan** (confirm), then **Make the plan active again**.
steps.expect: Retired plans leave the pricing page and the manual subscription form; their OTAs keep them; `/plans` shows 'Retired, not offered'.
